_comment: AR Aging TV board config. Edit this file, commit it, and Netlify redeploys in about 30 seconds. Nothing secret belongs in here.

report._comment: Leave category null and the discovery endpoint will find it for you, then paste the value it reports back in here.

ar._bucketModeNote: exclusive = a customer appears on exactly one view (90+, 60-89, 30-59). nested = 90+, 60+, 30+, so a 200-day-old balance shows on all three.
ar._sortNote: balance = biggest money first. days = oldest first.

privacy._note: nameStyle: full | initial | hidden. Set to initial if anyone who is not an employee can see this screen.

ar._collectorsNote: Optional. Maps a customer name exactly as it appears in ServiceTitan to whoever owns collecting it. Leave empty until the board is running.
